name: Steinbichlhof
beschreibung: The Steinbichlhof is centrally situated in Neustift im Stubaital, just steps from the parish church. This traditional inn combines authentic Tyrolean hospitality with a wonderfully cosy atmosphere. Guests can savour hearty regional cuisine in the rustic restaurant and unwind in the authentic alpine lounge in the evening. For hikers and nature enthusiasts, it offers effortless access to scenic mountain trails and top attractions throughout the Stubai Valley.
